title: knowledge.read input

resource.description: One exact knowledge://root_key/URL-encoded-relative-path from workspace files[].source_uri, or one exact unique filename including its extension. Preserve filename spaces and case. Do not pass knowledge-workspace:// overview URIs, knowledge-status:// status URIs, absolute filesystem paths, directories or natural-language instructions. When the filename is ambiguous, select a returned candidate source_uri or ask the user; do not repeat an unchanged invalid resource.

description: Read one complete authorized TXT/Markdown/PDF file without indexing. A directory overview or operation status is not document content.
